question: Could you analyze our data and identify which ten-year period starting from any movie release year present in the data had the largest number of films, considering consecutive ten-year periods beginning at each unique year? Only output the start year and the total count for that specific period.
sql:
-- Get the single top result
WITH year_counts AS (
    SELECT TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(year, -4) AS INTEGER) AS numeric_year
    FROM Movie
    WHERE TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(year, -4) AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
),
unique_start_years AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT numeric_year AS start_year
    FROM year_counts
),
period_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        us.start_year,
        COUNT(m.MID) AS film_count
    FROM unique_start_years us
    LEFT JOIN Movie m 
        ON TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(m.year, -4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN us.start_year AND us.start_year + 9
    GROUP BY us.start_year
)
SELECT start_year, film_count
FROM period_counts
ORDER BY film_count DESC, start_year ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH year_counts AS (
    SELECT TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(year, -4) AS INTEGER) AS numeric_year
    FROM Movie
    WHERE TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(year, -4) AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
),
unique_start_years AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT numeric_year AS start_year
    FROM year_counts
),
period_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        us.start_year,
        COUNT(m.MID) AS film_count
    FROM unique_start_years us
    LEFT JOIN Movie m 
        ON TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(m.year, -4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN us.start_year AND us.start_year + 9
    GROUP BY us.start_year
)
SELECT start_year, film_count
FROM period_counts
WHERE film_count >= 1200
ORDER BY film_count DESC, start_year ASC
